==English==

===Etymology===
From {{compound|en|method|air}}. From being a method to make it appear that the person has achieved a higher altitude than they actually have.

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Flame, not lame-method air.wav|a=US}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|snowboarding|skateboarding}} A trick where the boarder grabs the [[heel]] edge of the board with their front hand, between their feet, and then pulls the board towards their back, while arching their back and bending knees.
